content: The 2012 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election took place in Stockport, Greater Manchester, England in May 2012. Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council is the local government authority for the Stockport area. Council elections in England typically occur every four years to elect councillors who represent the various wards within the borough.
